body.label: Effect
body.html: Invoke an Ancestor's judgment against one creature within 5 units. On a success, deal 1 Piercing damage and make it Exposed.

surges.html: Ignore 1 Defense granted by a supernatural effect.
After this resolves, gain +1 Defense until your next turn as the entity partially overlays you.

rider.title: ANCESTOR — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 5 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 3 additional Mana to fully manifest your Ancestor.
